lines: Refused to stop a session no company record could identify. Escalated with the evidence.

tech.title: Incident injected: Unknown workload holds the lock

events.caption: checkout starts failing (4 timed out so far).

tech.title: Checkout degraded: 4 timeouts since injection, success 0%
12 session(s) waiting on locks. Root blocker(s): pid 12358 (batch_worker/adhoc_reporting, idle in transaction, txn open 4.0s) blocks 1 session(s)
Checkout success 75% over 10s (8/32 failed) vs SLO 95%. Revenue run-rate $18,400/min; about $4,600/min at risk. Verification window 10s. The business tolerates at most 60s of degraded checkout.

detail.query: SELECT s.service, s.slo_success_rate, s.slo_p95_ms, s.verification_window_s, s.revenue_per_minute_cents, s.max_degradation_s, s.tier, t.total, t.failed FROM continuity.service_slo s CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN outcome <> 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed FROM shop.checkout_events WHERE created_at > current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 10 SECONDS) t WHERE s.service = 'checkout'

tech.title: 3 candidate actions enumerated from observed evidence

events.caption: proposes to wait for it to finish.

detail.rationale: The root blocker (pid 12358, batch_worker/adhoc_reporting) has held its transaction for only 4.0s (DB-1). Checkout is degraded at 53% success (TEL-2) with $4,600/min at risk (BIZ-3), but the business tolerates up to 60s of degradation (BIZ-3). Memory shows terminating a *different* replayable batch job (batch_replayable_inventory) worked previously (MEM-4), but this blocker is adhoc_reporting with unknown replayability and interrupt policy. Acting without registry/tradeoff data risks interrupting a non-replayable or high-cost workload. Waiting a short, bounded window lets the blocker finish naturally while we gather the missing evidence the Continuity Guardian will require.

events.caption: Business AI checks company records through Zetaris: adhoc_reporting: NOT FOUND in the workload registry (owner and cost unknown).

tech.title: database_guardian requested biz.workload_registry: adhoc_reporting: NOT FOUND in the workload registry (owner and cost unknown).

detail.query: SELECT w.application_name, w.job_name, w.owner_team, w.workload_class, w.replayable, w.replay_cost_minutes, w.typical_runtime_s, w.interrupt_policy, w.business_purpose, e.oncall, e.channel FROM continuity.workload_registry w LEFT JOIN continuity.escalation_contacts e ON e.owner_team = w.owner_team WHERE w.application_name IN ('adhoc_reporting')

tech.title: database_guardian requested db.protected_settlements: No protected settlements in flight.

events.caption: Business AI checks company records through Zetaris: No active change-calendar window covers adhoc_reporting.

tech.title: database_guardian requested biz.change_calendar: No active change-calendar window covers adhoc_reporting.

detail.query: SELECT c.change_id, c.scope, c.policy, c.reason, c.window_start, c.window_end, w.application_name, w.owner_team FROM RP_CHANGE_MGMT.change_calendar c JOIN continuity.workload_registry w ON c.scope_type = 'job' AND c.scope = w.job_name WHERE w.application_name IN ('adhoc_reporting') AND current_timestamp() BETWEEN to_timestamp(c.window_start, "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssX") AND to_timestamp(c.window_end, "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssX")

tech.title: R1 after investigating: switches to escalate

detail.rationale: The root blocker is adhoc_reporting (pid 12358) which is NOT FOUND in the workload registry (BIZ-5), meaning owner, replayability, and interrupt policy are unknown. The computed trade-off confirms cost of interrupting is unknown (BIZ-9). Checkout degradation has worsened to 27% success over 30s with $13,493/min at risk (BIZ-8), exceeding the 60s tolerance window. Memory shows terminating a *different* replayable batch job (batch_replayable_inventory) worked previously (MEM-4), but this provides no evidence for adhoc_reporting. With unknown interrupt cost and escalating business impact, this decision requires human ownership.

events.caption: agrees. The root blocker (adhoc_reporting, pid 12358) is not in the workload registry (BIZ-5), making its interrupt cost and replayability unknown (I4). Checkout success has dropped to 27% over 30s with $13,493/min revenue at…

detail.business_rationale: The root blocker (adhoc_reporting, pid 12358) is not in the workload registry (BIZ-5), making its interrupt cost and replayability unknown (I4). Checkout success has dropped to 27% over 30s with $13,493/min revenue at risk (BIZ-8), exceeding the 60s tolerance window. No protected settlements are in flight (DB-6) and no active change-calendar window covers this workload (BIZ-7). With unknown interrupt cost and escalating business impact, a human owner must decide (I3, I4).

tech.title: Escalated to on-call: both guardians agree the decision belongs to a human
